text:
maria_cs: Quick heads up — customer 'Verdant Finance' requested a demo uplift next Mon. Needs EU + LATAM capacity and header allowlist because they rotate IPs.
jamal_support: What's target qps & time windows?
maria_cs: ~220 sustained, 400 peak; two windows 2026-05-04 13:00-17:00 UTC and 2026-05-05 13:00-17:00 UTC.
devon_eng: Recommend header pin, route to eu-west-1 & sa-east-1, pin model to v2-small, pre-warm KV cache 20m prior. Will provide warmup prompts.
karen_oncall: Ops: do 10% canary for 10m, autorevert at 72h, alerts for p50>250ms or 5xx spike >1%. Page on alerts.
jamal_support: Draft payload:
POST /v1/overrides {"customer":"verdant-fin","regions":["eu-west-1","sa-east-1"],"allowlist":{"type":"header","name":"x-verdant-demo","value":"demo-May"},"rate_override":{"qps":400,"burst":700},"duration":"72h","autorevert":true}
jamal_support: Applying to staging canary now.
deploy-bot: change-request 3087659999: applying route override to staging (10%).
deploy-bot: change-success 3087660020: staging canary healthy. No errors.
jamal_support: Rolling to prod 100% now; scheduling autorevert 72h out; TTL allowlist 7d.
deploy-bot: change-success 3087660100: prod override applied to eu-west-1 & sa-east-1. QA smoke passed.
maria_cs: Added runbook link to renewal brief. AE will confirm header value and supply warmup prompts.
karen_oncall: Runbook: https://playbooks.internal/demo-verdant-runbook
jamal_support: Ticket CS-1499 created with rollout details.
maria_cs: Will close once AE confirms demo outcome. :thumbsup:
